main_text.p: tur. Ita r. Reg. 18. 21 alloquitur Elias propheta huc in modum Israelitas. Si DOMINUS est Deus ipse, sequimini eum, sin autem istorum Baal, sequimini eum. Esa. 52. [?] ita ait Dominus: Discedite, discedite, exite illinc, & immundum ne attingitote: exite e medio istius &c. Hos. 4. 15. & 16. 8. dixit Dominus Judæis. Ne ascendatis Bethaven: nam licet fuerit Bethel, id est, domus Dei, nomine, tamen erat Bethaven, id est, domus vanitatis, te. act. 19. 9. legitur de Paulo, quòd, quum quidam ex Judæorum antistitibus indurarentur & non assentirentur sermoni, male loquentes de via illa Dei in conspectu multitudinis, abscedens ab illis separaverit discipulos. 2. Cor. 6. 14. & seq. generale hoc exstat mandatum: Ne impari jugo copulamini cum infidelibus: quod enim consortium justitiæ cum legis transgressione? & quæ communio lucis cum tenebris? & quæ concordia Christo cum Belial? aut quæ portio fideli cū infideli? & quæ cōsensio tēplo Dei cum simulacris.

page.notes: Head of page: printed page number "3". Several abbreviations and numerals in the Latin are uncertain at the scan's resolution, especially the chapter number after "Esa." and "te." before "act.", which are marked [?] or copied as best read. The page has no running head. The small mark "4" at the lower left edge is outside the printed text block and was not transcribed. The left margin contains only text from the neighbouring page, which was excluded.
